premises: Serrated flow in HEAs is linked to dynamic strain aging (DSA) and solute-dislocation interactions
DSA in HEAs involves pinning by solutes from the whole-solute matrix, leading to a higher strengthening rate than conventional alloys
Serration behavior in HEAs is observed at specific temperature and strain rate combinations (e.g., low temperatures or elevated temperatures at ~10⁻⁴ s⁻¹)
